-- ============================================================================
-- CRESCENT RECLAIM - CAMPUS LOST & FOUND PORTAL
-- MySQL Relational Database Schema
-- Submitted by: M. MOHAMED ASKAR (Reg No: 240071601159)
-- B.S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science & Technology
-- ============================================================================

CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS crescent_lost_found CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
USE crescent_lost_found;

-- 1. Table for Reported Lost & Found Items
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
    id VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY,
    type ENUM('lost', 'found') NOT NULL,
    status ENUM('active', 'claim_pending', 'reunited') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
    category VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    title VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    `desc` TEXT NOT NULL,
    zone VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    exact_spot VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    photo_url VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    reporter_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    reporter_email VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    reporter_phone VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT NULL,
    reporter_reg VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 2. Table for Submitted Claims
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS claims (
    id VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY,
    item_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    claimant_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    claimant_reg VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    claimant_email VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    claimant_phone VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    proof_details TEXT NOT NULL,
    status ENUM('pending', 'verified', 'rejected') DEFAULT 'pending',
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (item_id) REFERENCES items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 3. Table for Automated Email Dispatch Logs
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS email_logs (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    recipient_email VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    recipient_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    subject VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    item_title VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    body_html TEXT NOT NULL,
    claimant_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    sent_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- ============================================================================
-- CRESCENT RECLAIM - SUPABASE & NEON CLOUD POSTGRESQL SCHEMA
-- Developer: M. MOHAMED ASKAR (Reg No: 240071601159)
-- B.S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science & Technology
-- ============================================================================

-- 1. Items Table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.items (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('lost', 'found')),
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'claim_pending', 'reunited')),
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    "desc" TEXT NOT NULL,
    zone TEXT NOT NULL,
    exact_spot TEXT NOT NULL,
    photo_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    reporter_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    reporter_email TEXT NOT NULL,
    reporter_phone TEXT,
    reporter_reg TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 2. Claims Table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.claims (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES public.items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    claimant_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    claimant_reg TEXT NOT NULL,
    claimant_email TEXT NOT NULL,
    claimant_phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    proof_details TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 3. Email Outbound Logs Table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.email_logs (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    recipient_email TEXT NOT NULL,
    recipient_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    subject TEXT NOT NULL,
    item_title TEXT NOT NULL,
    body_html TEXT NOT NULL,
    claimant_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 4. Enable Row Level Security (RLS) & Public Read/Write for Campus Portal
ALTER TABLE public.items ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.claims ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.email_logs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY "Allow Public Read Items" ON public.items FOR SELECT USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "Allow Public Insert Items" ON public.items FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY "Allow Public Read Claims" ON public.claims FOR SELECT USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "Allow Public Insert Claims" ON public.claims FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (true);

WORKDIR /app

COPY index.html ./

EXPOSE 5000

CMD ["node", "server.js"]

services:

    name: crescent-reclaim-portal
    env: node
    plan: free
    buildCommand: "echo 'No build required for pure Node.js engine'"
    startCommand: "node server.js"
    envVars:
      - key: NODE_ENV
        value: production
      - key: PORT
        value: 10000

{
  "version": 2,
  "buildCommand": "echo 'Build complete'",
  "functions": {
    "server.js": {
      "includeFiles": "index.html"
    }
  },
  "rewrites": [
    {
      "source": "/api/(.*)",
      "destination": "/server.js?__api=$1"
    },
    {
      "source": "/(.*)",
      "destination": "/server.js"
    }
  ]
}

################################################################################

# Crescent ReClaim â€” Campus Lost & Found Portal

**Author:** M. MOHAMED ASKAR  
**Reg No:** 240071601159  
**Degree:** II B.Sc. Computer Science  
**Institution:** B.S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science & Technology  
**Faculty Guide:** Dr. K. Palanivel, M.Sc., M.Phil., Ph.D., N.E.T., Assistant Professor  

---

## ðŸŒŸ Overview
Crescent ReClaim is a full-stack campus web portal designed to replace messy, buried WhatsApp group messages with a centralized, verified recovery system for lost and found student belongings (Calculators, ID cards, Bike keys, Water bottles, Notebooks, Headphones).

---

## ðŸ—„ï¸ Backend Architecture

### 1. Node.js + SQLite Production Engine (Ready-to-Run)
* **Runtime:** Node.js (Built-in HTTP & native `node:sqlite` database engine)
* **Zero Dependencies:** Runs out-of-the-box on your machine without requiring `npm install` or external database services.
* **Database File:** `crescent_reclaim.db` (Persistent relational SQLite database)
* **Uploads Directory:** `./uploads` (Local file storage for item photos)

### 2. Relational Database Tables
* **`items` Table:**
  * `id` (VARCHAR PK)
  * `type` ('lost' or 'found')
  * `status` ('active', 'claim_pending', 'reunited')
  * `category` (Electronics, Cards, Keys, Bottles, Stationery, Bags)
  * `title`, `desc`, `zone`, `exact_spot`, `photo_url`
  * `reporter_name`, `reporter_email`, `reporter_phone`, `reporter_reg`
  * `created_at` (TIMESTAMP)
* **`claims` Table:**
  * `id` (VARCHAR PK)
  * `item_id` (FK to `items.id`)
  * `claimant_name`, `claimant_reg`, `claimant_email`, `claimant_phone`
  * `proof_details` (Unique identifying details submitted by student)
  * `status`, `created_at`
* **`email_logs` Table:**
  * `id` (INTEGER AUTOINCREMENT PK)
  * `recipient_email`, `recipient_name`, `subject`, `item_title`, `body_html`
  * `sent_at` (TIMESTAMP)

---

## ðŸ”Œ REST API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `GET` | `/api/items` | Fetch all reports with query filters (`?type=...&category=...&zone=...&search=...&sort=...`) |
| `POST` | `/api/items` | Log a new lost/found report with photo storage |
| `POST` | `/api/items/:id/claim` | File a verified claim & trigger automated email alert to finder |
| `GET` | `/api/metrics` | Real-time database metrics (total reports, active found, reunited count) |
| `GET` | `/api/emails` | Outgoing email alert audit logs |
| `PATCH`| `/api/items/:id/resolve` | Mark an item as reunited with owner |

---

## ðŸš€ How to Run the Backend

### Method 1: One-Click Windows Launch
Double-click:
```
start-server.bat
```
*(This automatically boots the SQLite database server and opens `http://localhost:5000` in your browser).*

### Method 2: Command Line
Open terminal in `campus-lost-and-found` and run:
```bash
node server.js
```
Then visit: `http://localhost:5000`

---

## ðŸ˜ PHP & MySQL Alternative (For Academic Submission)
If you need to submit PHP & MySQL code to Dr. K. Palanivel as per your internship syllabus, the complete PHP backend files are included in the `php-backend/` folder:
* `php-backend/database.sql` â€” MySQL database creation and table schemas.
* `php-backend/config.php` â€” PDO MySQL connection script.
* `php-backend/api.php` â€” Complete PHP REST API handling items, claims, and metrics.

# Complete Deployment Guide â€” Crescent ReClaim
**Portal Creator:** M. MOHAMED ASKAR (Reg No: 240071601159)  
**Institution:** B.S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science & Technology  

---

## ðŸŽ¯ The Deployment Challenge & How We Solved It
On cloud platforms (Render, Vercel, Railway, Heroku):
1. **Ephemeral Filesystems:** Files saved to a local folder like `./uploads/` get deleted when serverless containers sleep or rebuild.
2. **Database Persistence:** Local SQLite files reset unless stored on a persistent volume or cloud database.

### Our Solution for 100% Data Persistence:
* **Permanent Photo Visibility:** The portal's frontend automatically optimizes & compresses uploaded smartphone photos (max 900px, 82% quality WebP/JPEG) and stores the data URI directly inside the database row `photo_url`. **This ensures uploaded photos NEVER break, never 404, and stay permanently visible across all devices worldwide.**
* **Dual Database Engine:** 
  - Works with native SQLite out-of-the-box (`crescent_reclaim.db`).
  - Supports **Cloud PostgreSQL** (Neon.tech or Supabase) simply by setting the `DATABASE_URL` environment variable.

---

## ðŸš€ Option 1: Deploy to Render.com (Recommended & 100% Free)
Render is the easiest way to deploy this full-stack Node.js app with zero code changes.

### Step 1: Push Code to GitHub
1. Create a free GitHub account if you don't have one: [github.com](https://github.com).
2. Create a new repository named `crescent-reclaim`.
3. Push the `campus-lost-and-found` folder to your GitHub repository:
   ```bash
   cd campus-lost-and-found
   git init
   git add .
   git commit -m "Initial commit of Crescent ReClaim portal"
   git branch -M main
   git remote add origin https://github.com/<your-username>/crescent-reclaim.git
   git push -u origin main
   ```

### Step 2: Deploy on Render
1. Go to [render.com](https://render.com) and sign up with GitHub.
2. Click **New +** -> **Web Service**.
3. Select your `crescent-reclaim` GitHub repository.
4. Fill in the settings:
   - **Name:** `crescent-reclaim`
   - **Region:** Singapore or Frankfurt (fastest for India)
   - **Environment:** `Node`
   - **Build Command:** *(leave empty or `npm install`)*
   - **Start Command:** `node server.js`
   - **Instance Type:** `Free`
5. Click **Deploy Web Service**!
6. In ~60 seconds, Render will assign you a live HTTPS URL:
   `https://crescent-reclaim.onrender.com`

---

## âš¡ Option 2: Deploy to Vercel (Instant Serverless)
This project is already pre-configured for Vercel with `vercel.json` and `api/index.js`.

### Steps:
1. Push your repository to GitHub.
2. Go to [vercel.com](https://vercel.com) and click **Add New Project**.
3. Import your `crescent-reclaim` repository.
4. Click **Deploy**!
5. Vercel automatically routes `/api/*` to the serverless backend and serves `index.html` on its Global CDN.

---

## ðŸš‚ Option 3: Deploy to Railway / Koyeb (Docker Container)
A production-ready `Dockerfile` is included in this repository.

1. Go to [railway.app](https://railway.app) or [koyeb.com](https://koyeb.com).
2. Click **Deploy from GitHub repo**.
3. Railway/Koyeb will automatically detect `Dockerfile` and spin up the production container on port 5000.

---

## ðŸ—„ï¸ Option 4: Connect Free Cloud PostgreSQL (Neon / Supabase)
If you want an independent cloud database hosted separately:

1. Create a free PostgreSQL database at [neon.tech](https://neon.tech) or [supabase.com](https://supabase.com).
2. Open the **SQL Editor** in Neon/Supabase and paste the contents of `supabase-schema.sql`. Click **Run**.
3. Copy your database connection string:
   `postgresql://username:password@ep-xyz.neon.tech/neondb?sslmode=require`
4. On your Render/Railway dashboard, add an Environment Variable:
   - **Key:** `DATABASE_URL`
   - **Value:** *(paste your connection string)*
5. The portal will automatically connect to your cloud database!

---

## âœ… Post-Deployment Verification Checklist
1. Visit your live deployment URL on your mobile phone and laptop.
2. Verify that creator branding: `M. MOHAMED ASKAR | Reg: 240071601159` is visible at the top-left corner.
3. Click **"+ Report an Item"**, upload a photo from your phone, and submit.
4. Refresh the page on another device or computer: the new item and photo will appear immediately from the database!
5. Click **"Claim This Item"**, enter proof, and verify that the claim alert is generated.
